paraphrase: For all state and evidence types, data projections and supplied correctness predicates, an exact Prop-valued classifier using only those data exists iff correctness is invariant between equal-data states. Control: two Boolean states have identical unanimously positive report pairs and opposite correctness, so no classifier on those pairs is exact; identity data admit an exact classifier for that same nonconstant norm. No decidability, warrant or observer-number result follows.
